name: Jackfruit Pod
creator: RISD Nature Lab
attribution: Jackfruit Pod by RISD Nature Lab, licensed under CC BY 4.0.
usage: One scanned fruit specimen in Language → শব্দভাণ্ডার → ফল. It is a jackfruit pod, not the tree or a representative of all varieties.
modifications: Simplified with glTF Transform 4.5.1 to a target vertex ratio of 0.2 and error threshold 0.003.
Kept texture dimensions at 1024px and encoded as WebP quality 85.
Quantized vertex attributes using standard KHR_mesh_quantization.
limitations: The Sketchfab source reports that the 1M-triangle original is too heavy to render on some devices; the web derivative was optimized for runtime use.
A scanned fruit specimen is not a growing jackfruit tree and does not represent all jackfruit varieties.
Static scan with no authored animation.
